[^comment-STJXV04P279A-1]: Sahlah bint Suhayl is mentioned three times in HSNX (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P322A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 322) as one of the first to migrate to Abyssinia, <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P365A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 365) as one of the first to return from Abyssinia, and <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P368H</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 368) where she is mentioned again as one of the returnees from Abyssinia, where she is also mentioned by <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī) and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī). She is also mentioned in <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī), <a href="WASKA.html" class="witness-link">WASKA</a> (ʿAbdah (ʿAbd al-Raḥmān) b. Sulaymān al-Kilābī al-Kūfī), and <a href="WHAYA.html" class="witness-link">WHAYA</a> (Yazīd b. Hārūn al-Wāsiṭī) but in a different context. This passage is not found in HSNX but appears to be an aside common in Ibn Isḥāq. Placement is based on her first mention.
[^comment-STRDV01P293A-1]: <a href="../references.html#ref-STRD" class="source-ref">STRDV01P293A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Al-Rawḍ al-dānī</span>, vol. 1 p. 293) states لم يروه عن العلاء بن هارون إلا أسباط تفرد به ابن أبي الرباب ولا يحفظ للعلاء بن هارون إلا دون عشرة أحاديث مخارجها من الرملة وأظنه كان وقع إلى الرملة من العراق لأنا لا نحفظ عن الواسطيين عنه شيئا وهو ثقة.&quot;
